text: When the earlier promise is recalled, the distance between it and this command appears less than it did. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and it is this promise that God turns into a trial of Abraham. Much depends on a single word, _hineni_, "here I am," which becomes a word of loss as much as of presence. Its sense alters each time. Abraham speaks it three times, and each time it costs him more: first to God, then to Isaac, and last to the angel.
